summary: Unapplied provisional credits after cross-currency reconciliation delay caused negative provisional balance
description:
Issue summary: AtlasInsights reports a negative provisional credit balance on their March invoice preview. Provisional credits that normally apply after hourly postbacks were not applied for a ~3 hour window on 2026-03-09 due to a delayed cross-currency reconciliation job. The reconciliation job runs after postback aggregation to convert usage from customer currency (EUR) to billing currency (USD) and to calculate provisional credits.

Impact: Customer-facing invoice preview shows a -$1,240 provisional balance that is blocking autopay and their finance team from approving the finalized invoice. This has caused a billing hold and manual intervention request from their billing team. No production requests were affected; this is a metering/invoicing discrepancy only.

Environment: prod account for AtlasInsights (org id: atlas-2741), eu-west region. Affected time window: 2026-03-09 02:00 - 05:15 UTC. Affected services: postback-reconciler, billing-reconciler, currency-conversion pipelines.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Query usage postbacks for org atlas-2741 for 2026-03-09 01:30-06:00 UTC in postback DB.
2) Run the local billing-reconciler conversion step with the same postbacks but force the currency conversion step to be skipped (simulate delayed fx-run).
3) Generate provisional credit allocation and preview invoice; observe provisional credits missing for the 02:00-05:15 window leading to a negative provisional balance.
4) Re-run reconciliation with FX rates applied and provisional credits are produced, balance returns to expected positive allocation.
logs: 2026-03-09T05:16:12Z postback-reconciler ERROR: fx-conversion job timeout after 300s; retry scheduled (job id: fx-20260309-281)
2026-03-09T05:20:03Z billing-reconciler WARN: partial-aggregation detected: 9 postback batches missing currency tag eur->usd (agg window 02:00-03:00) (run id: br-790)
2026-03-09T05:45:47Z postback-reconciler INFO: delayed-fx-run completed, 100% of outstanding batches converted (job id: fx-20260309-281-complete)

2026-03-09T06:00:01Z invoice-generator INFO: provisional-credits applied for run br-790-postfix, but the provisional credit application step missed mapping to invoice preview snapshot id: preview-20260309-06-00
investigation_notes: Initial triage by CS (Maya): validated negative provisional balance on customer invoice preview and collected invoice preview id and sample postbacks.
SRE (Liam): found a delayed fx-conversion job due to transient downstream exchange-rate API timeouts between 05:00-05:15 UTC; reconciler retried and completed at 05:45 UTC.

Hypothesis: delay caused the invoicing pipeline to snapshot preview before provisional credits were merged; a race between invoice preview snapshotting and late-arriving credit allocation (ordering bug in preview snapshotter).
Reproducer: locally re-running reconciler with the same late batches reproduces missing provisional-credit-to-preview mapping (missing preview-merge event).
Risk: If invoice preview snapshots are finalized before reconciliation completes, autopay blocks can occur for enterprise customers during FX or reconciliation delays.
resolution_notes: Workaround applied (2026-03-11): retriggered invoice preview merge for AtlasInsights with corrected provisional credits; finance confirmed the preview now shows a +$4,560 provisional credit and autopay is no longer blocked.
Code fix (backlog): patch to invoice-generator to retry preview snapshot merge when late credit batches arrive (PR filed: github.com/redwood-inference/invoice-generator/pull/77).

Operational fix (deployed 2026-03-12): postback-reconciler now tags incomplete previews and delays final snapshot for up to 30 minutes if FX job has not completed; rollout verified in eu-west staging then prod.
Follow-up: Add monitoring alert for fx-conversion job latency > 2m (owner: billing team). Owner assigned: Liam O'Connor.
